info.title: cdidx
info.description: AI-native local code index for CLI and MCP workflows. Index source code into SQLite, search with FTS5, and return structured results for humans and agents. / CLIとMCPワークフロー向けのAIネイティブなローカルコードインデックス。ソースコードをSQLiteにインデックスし、FTS5で検索し、人間とAI向けに構造化された結果を返す。

options.name: --rebuild
options.description: Delete existing DB and rebuild from scratch

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show per-file status ([OK  ]/[SKIP]/[DEL ]/[ERR ])

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Scan files without writing to the database

options.name: --json
options.description: Output as JSON (streaming hits use JSON lines; counts/summaries use one object)

options.name: --commits
options.description: Update only files changed in the specified git commits (preferred after commits)

options.name: --files

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help message

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --license
options.description: Show licensing, trademark, and commercial-use summary

options.name: --completions
options.description:
Generate shell completions (bash, zsh, fish)
Update workflows:
Use --commits with a project path after normal commits; git diff sees rename/delete paths too.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Max results to return (default: 20)

options.name: --lang
options.description: Filter by language (aliases: bat, cmd, cshtml, razor, ts, tsx, cts, mts)

options.name: --path
options.description: Restrict matches to glob-style path patterns (* and ?)

options.name: --query
options.description: Pass a query literal, useful when the query starts with '-'

options.name: --exclude-path
options.description: Exclude glob-style path patterns (* and ?) (repeatable)

options.name: --exclude-tests
options.description: Exclude likely test files

options.name: --snippet-lines
options.description: Search snippet length (1-20, default: 8)

options.name: --max-line-width
options.description: search/references/find/excerpt/inspect only: clamp very long single-line snippet/context/excerpt payloads (`0` disables clamping; default: 512)

options.name: --focus-line
options.description: excerpt: line whose focused column should stay visible (requires --focus-column)

options.name: --focus-column
options.description: excerpt: column to keep centered when clamping (must be within the focused line)

options.name: --focus-length
options.description: excerpt: width of the focused span (default: 1, requires --focus-column)

options.name: --fts
options.description: Use raw FTS5 query syntax for search (trailing * is a prefix shorthand in literal-safe mode)

options.name: --exact
options.description: Backward-compatible shorthand. Prefer --exact-substring for search, keep --exact for find, and prefer --exact-name for symbols/definition/references/callers/callees/inspect.

options.name: --exact-substring
options.description: Search only: case-sensitive exact substring (no FTS5)

options.name: --exact-name
options.description: symbols/definition/references/callers/callees/inspect: NFKC + Unicode CaseFold exact name match (legacy/stale-fold DBs fall back to ASCII NOCASE; use `cdidx backfill-fold` or check `status --json` fold_ready)

options.name: --kind
options.description: definition/symbols/hotspots/unused: symbol kind; references: reference kind (call/instantiate/subscribe/attribute/annotation); callers/callees: call-graph kinds only (call/instantiate/subscribe — metadata kinds rejected, use references instead); validate: issue kind

options.name: --count
options.description: Count only; search/definition/references/callers/callees/symbols/files/find/unused ignore --limit, impact/hotspots still use visible page counts

options.name: --since
options.description: Filter to files modified since this timestamp (ISO 8601)

options.name: --depth
options.description: Max BFS depth for impact analysis (default: 5)

options.name: --reverse
options.description: Reverse direction for deps (show dependents)

options.name: --group-by-name
options.description:
hotspots: collapse rows sharing (name, kind) across files into one line
Note: if a query itself starts with '-', pass it with --query <query> or -- <query>; for option values that start with '--', use --opt=<value>.
